## TemplateEngine.\_processGScriptBlocks() method

Block: g-script Transforms `<g-script>` blocks into executable JavaScript expressions.

**Signature:**

```typescript
static _processGScriptBlocks(template: string): string;
```

## Remarks

This internal method converts `<g-script>` blocks into self-invoking functions that execute with access to the `data` object via `with(data)`<!-- -->. If the script throws an error or `data` is undefined, an empty string is returned. By design this executes developer-authored template code (templates are code, only `data` values are untrusted input); no strict/no-script mode is provided.

\*\*Attributes:\*\*  - none

## Example


```typescript
const template = '<g-script>return name ? `Hello ${name}` : `Hello`;</g-script>';
const processed = TemplateEngine._processGScriptBlocks(template);
// Result: '${(() => { if (!data) return ''; try { with(data) { return name ? `Hello ${name}` : `Hello`; } } catch(e) { return '' } })()}'
```
